760780101.text: Normally, once all the monsters that follow the Wild Hunt have been defeated, the stench of its taint should fade along with them.

760780102.text: But this fissure persists... Unusual, but not unprecedented.

760780103.text: Let's search the area. Perhaps something unclean still remains.

760780301.text: (Though the monsters have dispersed, the darkness has not faded. You may need to enlist the help of a professional who knows more about the Wild Hunt.)

760780201.text: Ah, a lantern. This is something that all Lightkeepers carry with them, and is a key tool in dispersing the Wild Hunt...

760780202.text: The lantern remains, and on its cover lingers the scent of the Wild Hunt's permeation. The bearer, however, is nowhere to be found.

760780203.text: I see. Though perplexing, it's not hard to conclude what happened here.

760780204.text: The sacrifices of our Lightkeeper brethren are sometimes silent as a whisper. Finding out my colleagues have passed in this way is... always a shame.

760780205.text: ...Allow me to carry the lantern you left behind, nameless one.

760780206.text: Its body will be cleansed, its light, rekindled. It will find a new home in the arms of another Lightkeeper who vows to protect Nod-Krai.

760780207.text: Flins cleans the lantern, then carefully puts it away.

760780208.text: This lantern must be why the Wild Hunt didn't completely disappear. I'll hold on to it until someone from headquarters can come to retrieve it.

760780209.text: ...Hold on, there's something underneath the lantern.

760780210.text: This must be a relic left behind by that same colleague. It should be kept together with their lantern.

760780401.text: Normally, once the nearby monsters are cleared out, the rifts around here should disappear on their own.

760780402.text: So why does the Wild Hunt's presence still linger...? This is far too strange.

760780403.text: Could there be something I’ve overlooked? Something else that's been tainted by the Wild Hunt?

760780501.text: There's an Oath Lantern here as well. It must have belonged to someone who came before us...

760780502.text: The lantern is still stained with the Wild Hunt's corruption. It's not hard to imagine what happened...

760780503.text: From the day we take up the Oath Lantern, our lives are bound to the flame within it, until the moment our rightful mission is fulfilled.

760780504.text: To you, who fought to your last breath for the peace and safety of Nod-Krai, I offer my deepest respect.

760780505.text: I will take your lantern for now. Rest assured, the crown of the honored fallen will keep your legacy safe.

760780506.text: I'll bring it back to headquarters, rekindle its flame, and entrust it to someone worthy of carrying your will forward.

760780507.text: Illuga cleans the lantern, then carefully puts it away.

760780508.text: With that, the Wild Hunt has been wiped out from this place, and our predecessor's spirit has finally found its rest.
